plan: This is the first round, so I have no history to learn from. With rational bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid slightly below your value. I will bid a bit below my value of $36 to try and secure a profit if I win. I will bid $35.5.

Since this is the first round, I have no history to learn from. The optimal bidding strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction, assuming all bidders are rational, is to bid slightly below my true value. This is because bidding my true value leaves me vulnerable to losing out on potential profit if another bidder bids slightly below my value. Bidding slightly below my value maximizes my expected profit. I will bid $30.9.
